prompt:
Research what the Home Assistant project has officially published about the number of active installations (its opt-in analytics). Cite the page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on the official Home Assistant Analytics data and project announcements, here are the published figures regarding active installations and opt-in statistics.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "695,026 Active Home Assistant Installations" | CLAIM: As of the data retrieved in October 2026, there are 695,026 active installations that have opted in to share analytics.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/statistics/ | QUOTE: "496,813 of 637,194 (77.97%) installations have chosen to share usage statistics" | CLAIM: At a specific point in time reflected in the statistics summary, 77.97% of the tracked user base had opted in to share data.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/analytics | QUOTE: "The Analytics system was introduced in Home Assistant 2021.4, and it's used by 76.5% of the active installations." | CLAIM: The project states that approximately 76.5% of active installations use the analytics integration.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2025/04/16/state-of-the-open-home-recap/ | QUOTE: "One big announcement Franck made was that this year we went from 1 million to over 2 million active installations in 2024!" | CLAIM: In April 2025, the project announced that the total number of active installations surpassed 2 million in 2024.

SOURCE: https://analytics.home-assistant.io/ | QUOTE: "We estimate that less than a fourth of all Home Assistant users opt in." | CLAIM: The analytics page explicitly notes that the opt-in data represents less than 25% of the total user base, indicating the actual installation count is significantly higher than the reported analytics numbers.

SOURCE: https://www.home-assistant.io/blog/2021/11/12/100k-analytics/ | QUOTE: "Our estimate is that there are 4-5x more installations than people that opt-in to analytics." | CLAIM: Historically, the project has estimated the total user base to be four to five times larger than the number of opt-in analytics users.
